ops.note:
60 runs total, across cc-context / cc-review / cc-transcript and both verdicts (36 earlier runs spanning 6 repos and both verdicts, plus 24 fresh denied-verdict runs on 2026-07-28). Distribution: min 5.47s, median ~7.0s, p90 9.7s, p95 10.9s, max 13.06s, plus one separate 17.9s reading. 3/24 of the fresh runs exceeded 10s.

`gtProbeTimeout` is 20s, derived from that distribution — 1.53x the observed max over 60 runs. The doc comment on the constant now carries the distribution rather than a headroom claim, and says explicitly that the 5s value came from a single ~1.5s sample, because re-deriving it from one run is what produced the bug.

Independently corroborated against the live server after release: a forced `--refresh` probe in cc-context took **10.35s** — above the old 5s cap (so it would have timed out) and below the new 20s one.
